verses.text: इ॒षे त्वा॑ ऊ॒र्जे त्वा॑ वा॒यवः॑ स्थ दे॒वो वः॑ सवि॒ता प्रार्प॑यतु॒ श्रेष्ठ॑तमाय॒ कर्म॑णे ।
verses.transliteration: iṣe tvā ūrje tvā vāyavaḥ stha devo vaḥ savitā prārpayatu śreṣṭhatamāya karmaṇe |
verses.translation: For sap thee, for juice thee! Ye are winds. May God Savitar impel you to the highest work!
Swell, O ye inviolable ones, for the portion of the Gods, full of juice, full of milk, rich in offspring, free from disease, free from sickness!
